Job Description: 
 Employer: IHC Health Services, Inc. (dba Intermountain Health) 
 Job Title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Machine Learning (ML) Engineer
 Degree Required: Master’s degree or equivalent foreign education
 Academic Discipline(s): Computer Science, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, or Statistics
 Experience Required: 1 year of experience in applied data science modeling or analytics
  
 Job Description: 
   
 Designs, develops, and tests AI and Machine Learning systems and solutions across a variety of business problems.
 Apply machine learning algorithms, deep learning, pretrained transformers, and statistical reasoning to create and optimize models.
 Use AI/ML programming languages and tools to develop machine learning pipelines and systems.
 Leverage cloud platforms and distributed computing to optimize machine learning models.
 Work closely with Machine Learning Operations Engineers to deploy AI and ML systems using software engineering best practices.
  
 Position may telecommute from any state in the United States except California, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, New York, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Washington.
  
 Minimum Qualifications: 
   
 Knowledge of applying machine learning algorithms, deep learning models, and transformer architectures to various data sets and problems.
 Knowledge of Python and SQL.
 Knowledge of statistical reasoning and probabilistic outcomes
 Knowledge of object-oriented programming design and systems
 Knowledge of version control processes and systems
 Knowledge of database structures and analytics engineering
 Knowledge of data analytics and business analytics
 Knowledge of cloud computing platforms and distributed computing best practices.
 
 Knowledge of Linux and bash scripting.
 Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP)
 Knowledge of Artificially Intelligence Agents and decision-making architecture
 Knowledge of all aspects of the data science life cycle including problem identification, data collection, data preparation, information/feature extraction, analytics method development, algorithm and model development, solution deployment and maintenance, customer consulting and communicating with non-technical business stakeholders.
   
 Upon hire, all applicants will be subject to drug testing/screening and background checks.
   
 Salary (Annual): $98,000.00 - $118,000.00
  
 Work Location: 36 S State St, Suite 2200, Salt Lake City, UT 84111. Position may telecommute from any state in the United States except California, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, New York, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Washington.
  
 Hours of Work: Usually 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday
  
 Applicants interested in applying for this position should go to https://imh.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/IntermountainCareers and search for the job title above or search for job number R187019 or email resume to Mary Hansen at mary.hansen@imail.org . Applicants who fail to provide a resume and pre-screening question responses will not be considered. This position is for permanent direct hire only; applications for contract labor will not be considered.

Key Bank Tower

Salt Lake City

40

 Intermountain Health is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
